title: planted-records init-stack test holds under parallel lane load
body:
Outcome: test/scripts/planted-records.test.ts "every applicable enforced record bites in each init stack" passes under the host load of three parallel lanes running npm run fast; today it takes 121 s alone and timed out at 60 s inside npm run fast on 2026-11-16 (S27 lane, fast log 1048 s), so fast verdicts go red without a defect.
Why: a load-dependent timeout turns every lane's fast into a false FAIL and costs a rerun per lane.
Proof: `node --test test/scripts/planted-records.test.ts` finishes under 60 s, or the test is split per stack with a per-stack timeout that holds under load.
